caption: The drawing shows a pair of pince-nez eyeglasses positioned near the top center of the page. The eyeglasses have two oval lenses with thin gold-colored rims and a decorative gold-colored nose bridge that connects the two lenses. Attached to the right side of the glasses is an oval loop, also gold-colored, possibly meant for holding or attaching a chain. Below the colored illustration are two technical line drawings in a faint gray—a front view and a side view—showing the same eyeglasses in outline form. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or markings except for a small artist signature in the lower left corner.
title: Lorgnette
